title: Best Laptop Under ₹25,000 in India (2026): 5 Budget Picks That Actually Run
description: Five laptops under ₹25,000 for students and home users in India in 2026, ranked — Acer Aspire 3 leads with Ryzen 3 and 7-hour battery. Plus one to skip.
short_desc: Five budget laptops that actually run — and one to skip.

headings.text: What actually matters in a laptop under ₹25,000
Our picks: 5 laptops that actually run

cta.headline: Want the full laptop comparison sheet?
cta.sub: Compare 25+ laptops under ₹25,000 — processor, RAM, SSD, battery, real user benchmarks.

faq.q: Can you get a good laptop under ₹25,000 in 2026?
faq.a: Yes, but with trade-offs. The Acer Aspire 3 and Asus VivoBook 15 deliver Intel Celeron or AMD Ryzen 3 performance that handles Office, Chrome, and video calls. Do not expect video editing or gaming.

faq.q: How much RAM do I need under ₹25,000?
faq.a: 8GB is non-negotiable in 2026 — 4GB is unusable with Chrome + a video call open. Most laptops in this range have 8GB soldered, so you cannot upgrade later.

faq.q: Should I get SSD or HDD under ₹25,000?
faq.a: Always SSD. Every pick on this list has 256GB or 512GB SSD. HDD-equipped laptops in this range feel sluggish within months.

faq.q: What is the battery life like on budget laptops?
faq.a: 5–7 hours is realistic for light use (Chrome, Office, video). The Acer Aspire 3 leads with 7 hours; most rivals are 5–6.

tldr_pick: The Acer Aspire 3 A315-24P is the best laptop under ₹25,000 in India in 2026 — AMD Ryzen 3 7320U, 8GB RAM, 512GB SSD, and 7-hour real battery life. Buy it at ₹23,990 on Amazon.
key_takeaways: 8GB RAM is non-negotiable: 4GB is unusable with Chrome + a video call open.
Skip the iBall CompBook: 4GB RAM, 64GB eMMC, TN panel — feels slow within weeks.
Ryzen 3 beats Celeron: better multi-core performance for the same price.
Always SSD: HDD-equipped laptops in this range feel sluggish within months.
who_for: Students buying their first laptop, home users needing a secondary device, or anyone working from home who needs reliable performance for Office, Chrome, and video calls. If you do not edit video or game, this guide ranks the 5 best options under ₹25,000.
methodology: We compared 7 laptops under ₹25,000 available on Amazon India and Flipkart in 2026. For each, we evaluated processor performance, RAM type and capacity, SSD vs HDD, battery life (real-world video playback), display panel (TN vs IPS), keyboard quality, and verified user reviews. Picks validated against manufacturer specs and current sale pricing. Reviewed every 60 days.
